    objects.extend(build_small_hinge())

    footboard_height: float = 28.0
    # ... more fields, derived @property values, and _build_footboard/_side_rails/_headboard/_mattress ...
def build_model() -> list[bpy.types.Object]:
    """Build the bed from source dimensions and OpenSCAD-like primitive transforms."""
    dims = BedDimensions()
    objects: list[bpy.types.Object] = []

    objects.extend(_build_footboard(dims))
    objects.extend(_build_side_rails(dims))
    objects.extend(_build_headboard(dims))
    objects.append(_build_mattress(dims))

    return objects
